data.name: Abdullah
data.gender_notes: Abdullah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Slave of Allah, servant of God. The name Abdullah carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abdullah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the Servitude and Devotion and Faith nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Abdullah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdullah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
